items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: What were the most bands you had with the Butcher Brothers from Lafayette? ... He played drums with us.

ctx.x: Yeah. He plays good accompaniment. Mm-hmm. He plays good accompaniment. What were the most bands you had with the Butcher Brothers from Lafayette? Who were they? Uh, I feel like thinking of names. Warren? No, that's my thoughts. Warren, Warren, I thought. Uh, big old long legged or something. I can't think of him. What did he play? He played drums with us. And, uh, one played drums and the other one played. They have a place of business in Lafayette, Louisiana, and today it's Butcher Brothers. That's right.
I don't know what he's spelling all that.
